answer: Anchor each agent identity to a hardware-rooted attestation key, unique as an onyx — one key, one agent, issued only by a sanctioned enclave. Spawning ten thousand software fakes costs nothing, but minting ten thousand hardware-bound keys is prohibitive. Between epochs, require every agent to broadcast a freshness signal onto the shared ledger and take part in peer audits; identities that stay silent drift into a tundra of frozen privileges, locked out of payouts until working agents vouch for them. Sybil farms drown in their own dead identities.
